name: Ben's Bites

sources.title: Ben's Bites homepage - now a Substack newsletter landing page (171k+ subscribers)
Ben's Bites community board - 'Create an account and submit a post. Top voted posts get included in our daily newsletter'
Third-party description of the Ben's Bites community submit-and-upvote flow

conditions: Submission is free but requires creating an account on the community board at news.bensbites.co
Visibility is community-gated: top-voted posts get included in the daily newsletter; a submitted post without upvotes may only live on the board
news.bensbites.co returned a 522 origin error at fetch time — the community surface may be intermittently down
requirements: AI-focused audience — posts should be AI tools, launches, or AI news
Community voting decides newsletter inclusion — thin self-promo posts will likely get no traction
preparation: Email for account registration on news.bensbites.co
Post title, description, and product URL
A genuinely interesting angle — the newsletter audience is AI builders/investors
workflow: Go to https://news.bensbites.co (the community site — bensbites.com itself is only a Substack subscribe page)
Submit a post with the tool name, description, and URL
Post enters the community feed where users vote; top-voted posts are picked up for the daily newsletter (100k+ subscribers)
watchFor: bensbites.com and news.bensbites.co are different surfaces — the .com is a Substack newsletter signup with no submission form; the .co community board is the submit path
news.bensbites.co was returning HTTP 522 (Cloudflare origin down) during research — verify it is up before planning around it
Newsletter feature is merit-based on votes, not guaranteed by submission
Paid 'Advertise with us' option exists on the community site for guaranteed placement
countsAsLive: The submitted post is visible on the news.bensbites.co community feed; full success = inclusion in the daily newsletter email
unknowns: Whether news.bensbites.co is still actively operated (522 error observed 2026-09-25)
Whether the post page link is dofollow
Newsletter inclusion thresholds (vote count is not published)
